pinterest.title: Vacuum Lost Suction? It's Usually the Filter, a Clog or the Brush Roll
pinterest.description: Check the bin, filter, hose and brush roll before you replace it. Filters dry at least 24 hours. AI voice & visuals · #CommissionsEarned

instagram.caption:
vacuum lost suction? it's usually a full bin, a packed filter or hair on the brush roll. not the motor.

the usual mistake: putting the filter back damp. dyson and shark both say it has to be fully dry, so give it at least a day.

full fix-it order + our picks: link in bio.

save this for the next time it sounds fine and picks up nothing.

when a vacuum stops picking stuff up, what do you check first? bin, filter or hose?

youtube.title: vacuum lost suction? check this before replacing it #shorts
youtube.description:
empty the bin, rinse the filter (water only, dry at least 24 hours), clear the hose, cut the hair off the brush roll. most of the time that's it.
